en: \[VSCode] Fixed the "General config" menu row showing `/config` usage text instead of opening settings, and made typed `/mcp`, `/hooks`, `/memory`, `/rewind` and similar commands open their dialogs
zh: \[VSCode] 修复了“General config”菜单行显示 `/config` 用法文本而非打开设置的问题，并使键入的 `/mcp`、`/hooks`、`/memory`、`/rewind` 等命令打开其对话框
